name: architecture-sre-observability-suite
known_facts: SRE is about reliability engineering, not just monitoring
SLOs define targets, SLIs measure performance, error budgets track remaining risk
Four golden signals: latency, traffic, errors, saturation
Toil reduces toil, automation increases leverage
Blameless post-mortems are essential for learning culture

input.current_state: Reactive monitoring with basic CloudWatch dashboards, no SLOs defined, on-call rotation exists but no escalation policy
input.current_pager_fatigue: 15 alerts per night per engineer, 40% false positives
input.target_reliability: 99.95% uptime for transaction processing, 99.9% for reporting
input.key_dependencies: AWS (EKS, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS, MSK), Stripe, Plaid, Datadog
input.slo_1_sli_definition: Ratio of successful 200/201 responses to total payment authorization requests, measured per minute
input.error_budget_1: 0.05% = ~21 minutes of failed authorizations per month
input.slo_2_sli_definition: Ratio of successful read responses to total transaction history queries
input.error_budget_2: 0.1% = ~43 minutes of failed lookups per month
input.slo_3_sli_definition: Ratio of webhooks delivered within 30s to total webhooks triggered
input.error_budget_3: 0.01% = ~4 minutes of late deliveries per month
input.tools_logging: Datadog Logs with log-based metrics for all services
input.tools_tracing: Datadog APM with distributed tracing for 12 of 24 services
input.tools_dashboards: Service-specific dashboards in Datadog, no consistent dashboard standard
input.tools_oncall: PagerDuty with event intelligence and auto-escalation
input.tools_runbooks: Confluence-based runbooks, inconsistent coverage, rarely updated
input.gap_1: APM tracing coverage is only 50% of services, missing dependency mapping for remaining services
input.gap_1_fix: Enable Datadog APM auto-instrumentation for remaining 12 services, prioritize by traffic volume
input.gap_2: No centralized SLO dashboard -- SLOs exist in a spreadsheet, not in Datadog
input.gap_2_fix: Create Datadog SLO resources using Terraform, import existing targets from spreadsheet
input.gap_3: Runbooks are not tested during game days, only during incidents
input.gap_3_fix: Implement quarterly game days with runbook validation as a pass/fail criterion
